 Hello Marilyn, 

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 You’re receiving this email because you currently have an order or a pre-order with us that has not yet been delivered—possibly for quite some time (for some). 

 First, I want to personally apologize to those who have written to us recently (and even those who haven’t) and did not receive the follow-ups you are entitled to and that we usually provide.

 Before explaining the situation and our solutions, I want to reassure you that we are doing everything we can to ship your order before Christmas, and we are well on track to make it happen , despite everything. Cutting it a bit close, but still!

 We will send another update on December 19–20 to those who have not yet received their gift order, in order to offer two options: 

 
 
 Receive a free $25 Lasclay gift card to put under the tree, while waiting for the order, which may arrive slightly after Christmas.

 
 Cancel the order and receive a refund so you can purchase other gifts. This is something we truly hope to avoid at all costs, as we are a very young company carrying a lot on our shoulders: building an entire industrial supply chain from scratch by ourselves (milkweed!), juggling agricultural production, manufacturing, international e-commerce, a physical store, retailers, and everything that comes with it… all with a small team of 5 people.

 
 Each canceled order hurts us, but we completely understand as well.

 ______

 Since mid-November, rather unexpectedly, we have been literally flooded with orders. In less than 30 days, we received twice as many orders as the previous 120 days combined . We are also experiencing 189% growth compared to last fall , which was already a record season…

 As they say, it’s a good problem to have—but it’s still a problem. 

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Nevertheless , on our endm everything was ready for a situation like that , because for once, the production of our milkweed-insulated linings for all products was completed for the season, as early as the beginning of November.

 However, the bottleneck occurred with our subcontractors who assemble some of our more complex products (e.g., mittens), for several reasons beyond our control.

 To address this, we redistributed all of our linings to 5 new subcontractors : a major one employing more than 40 seamstresses, and 3 others closer to our own factory.

 We also called on an army of volunteers through our newsletter . Over the next 10 days, more than 25 of our precious customers will come lend a helping hand : finishing products, shipping orders, responding to customers, transportation, etc.

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 In short, if you’ve read this far, then this is the classic story of a small, young, ambitious company that’s taking big swings with somewhat small means (for now).

 We work extremely hard , but sometimes we lose our footing a bit when rapid growth like this hits. We want to reassure you that we are doing everything possible to deliver your order before Christmas and that we are well on track to make it happen , despite everything.

 Thank you so much Marilyn for your trust and your patience. We are working hard, day and night (literally), to deliver your order, and we won’t let you down. 

 We’ll get through this! 

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Thank you, and sorry again, 

 Gabriel 
Co-founder
Lasclay 

 

 
 
 

 
 

 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Lasclay inc.

messages.subject: A problem☹️
messages.text:
Dear Lasclay,

I am hoping that you can assist me from your end!! On November 19th 2024, I ordered 3 pairs of mittens from you…..that were supposed to be Christmas presents. I do understand that you were overwhelmed by orders, however, on December 19th 2024 I got a message from you that my order had been shipped….hooray! I then got a message from Canada Post that I would receive the parcel on December 23rd….but that did not happen. I then got another update from Canada Post to say that I would receive the delivery on December 29th….but that did not happen. I cannot get ANY information from Canada Post as where the parcel is now, and why I have never received it!! This whole experience has been very disappointing. Please could you help me? Three family members are still waiting for their Christmas presents, and I cannot give them any hope as to when it will arrive. NOW is the season when mitts would be very helpful.

Thank you very much,

Marilyn Taylor 

9448 Stevenson Rd.

Gore’s Landing, On.

K0K2E0

Sent from my iPad

messages.subject: My order has not arrived!!
messages.text:
Good morning,

I contacted you a couple of days ago to tell you that I still have not received my order from you. This morning I received another message from Canada Post to say that their investigation which I had requested did not find the parcel, and that I must contact the sender….which is you! As the 3 pairs of mittens were to be Christmas presents, it is very disappointing. I will attach screenshots of the information from Canada Post, as well as the communications from Lasclay. Any help to solve this mystery and to getting my order to me would be greatly appreciated.

Thank you,

Marilyn Taylor

Sent from my iPad

messages.subject: Mittens finally arrived!!
messages.text:
Dear Lasclay,

The mittens finally arrived yesterday (January 12th). They are lovely and look and feel just as expected. 

However, there is one problem that cannot be overcome by ignoring it😕. All 3 pairs of mitts have the same problem. Although they all say that they are a medium size, the left hand is significantly smaller then the right hand. Unfortunately, they will be impossible to wear. It is very noticeable just looking at them, but the problem becomes all too obvious when you try to put them on your hands.

Please tell me what to do. Do I send everything back to you? I could take a picture and send it to you if that would help.

I am so sorry that this experience has not gone better for both of us. My ‘kids’ who were to receive the mittens as gifts had read all about your company and were so excited to receive the mitts. They are all very concerned about the environment and think that your ‘mission’ is a wonderful idea. 

I await your instructions,

Marilyn Taylor 

905 342 3129

mbtaylor7@yahoo.ca

Sent from my iPad

Bonjour Louise,
 

 Désolé pour le délai de réponse plus long qu'à l'habitude et pour ce problème très inhabituel.
 

 

 Voici la marche à suivre pour un retour/échange: 
 

 1. Aller sur https://lasclay.happyreturns.com/ pour obtenir une étiquette de retour. Après avoir entré votre numéro de commande et votre code postal, il faut sélectionner les produits à retourner et ensuite choisir ceux qu'on veut en remplacement. À la fin, vous obtiendrez une étiquette de retour prépayée.
 

 2. Imprimer l'étiquette, emballer les produits à retourner et coller l'étiquette sur l'emballage. SVP privilégier l'utilisation d'enveloppes / sacs et non de boîtes, qui coûtent plus cher.
 

 3. Déposer dans une boîte rouge Postes Canada ou au bureau de Postes le plus près.
 

 4. Une fois le retour reçu, nous enverrons le(s) nouveau(x) produit(s). 😊
 

 Chaleureusement,
 __
 Gabriel 
 Co-fondateur 
 Lasclay

Merci beaucoup Gabriel! 

 On renvoie les 3 paires de mitaines de grandeur M et veut les échanger pour trois autres paires de grandeur LARGE.
 

 SVP vérifiez que chaque paire de mitaine est bien de la même longueur même si l’étiquette dit L. 
 Dans celles que nous allons renvoyer, elle n'étaient pas de la même longueur malgré le M sur les deux mains.
 

 CHeers
 Louise pour Marilyn Taylor
 

 Sent from my iPad

 
 On Jan 24, 2026, at 7:01 AM, Lasclay <hey@lasclay.com> wrote:

 
 ﻿ Bonjour Louise,
 

 Désolé pour le délai de réponse plus long qu'à l'habitude et pour ce problème très inhabituel.
 

 

 Voici la marche à suivre pour un retour/échange: 
 

 1. Aller sur https://lasclay.happyreturns.com/ pour obtenir une étiquette de retour. Après avoir entré votre numéro de commande et votre code postal, il faut sélectionner les produits à retourner et ensuite choisir ceux qu'on veut en remplacement. À la fin, vous obtiendrez une étiquette de retour prépayée.
 

 2. Imprimer l'étiquette, emballer les produits à retourner et coller l'étiquette sur l'emballage. SVP privilégier l'utilisation d'enveloppes / sacs et non de boîtes, qui coûtent plus cher.
 

 3. Déposer dans une boîte rouge Postes Canada ou au bureau de Postes le plus près.
 

 4. Une fois le retour reçu, nous enverrons le(s) nouveau(x) produit(s). 😊
 

 Chaleureusement,
 __
 Gabriel 
 Co-fondateur 
 Lasclay
